name: imp
description: A cross-platform MUD companion for live state, alerts, and trusted actions.

scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check . && node scripts/check-docs.mjs && node scripts/check-version.mjs
scripts.relay:lint: uv run --directory services/relay ruff check . && uv run --directory services/relay ruff format --check . && uv run --directory services/relay mypy src tests
scripts.tf:lint: uv run --directory integrations/tinyfugue ruff check . && uv run --directory integrations/tinyfugue ruff format --check . && uv run --directory integrations/tinyfugue mypy src tests
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run relay:lint && npm run relay:test && npm run adapter:lint && npm run adapter:test && npm run mudlet:lint && npm run mudlet:test && npm run tf:lint && npm run tf:test && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
scripts.adapter:lint: uv run --directory integrations/common ruff check . && uv run --directory integrations/common ruff format --check . && uv run --directory integrations/common mypy src tests
scripts.mudlet:lint: uv run --directory integrations/mudlet ruff check . && uv run --directory integrations/mudlet ruff format --check . && uv run --directory integrations/mudlet mypy src tests
